item.description:
# RunHuddle 0.13.1
- Added a reusable four-step Getting started guide covering agent connections, notifications, terminal switching, shortcuts, handoffs, and Saved work. - Added a startup checkbox, with permanent access from Help and General settings even when automatic opening is disabled. - Added Help menu links to the user guide, troubleshooting, and GitHub issues. - Notification permission remains opt-in through the guide’s Enable notifications button.
Validation: native build and release test suite; offscreen guide checks in light and dark appearance. Live macOS permission prompts are not exercised automatically.
